notes.title: Rainbow Six Extraction: Steam Release Day Livestream w/Ubisoft News!
notes.notes:
Now out on Steam! Rainbow Six Extraction takes your favorite Operators from Rainbow Six Siege and pits them against a deadly new threat in this tense, tactical PVE shooter.

Join Chastity Vicencio, Chris Watters, and Youssef Maguid from Ubisoft News as they celebrate by staying calm and collected, methodically eliminating their foes, and only mildly panicking under pressure.

Siege players unlock extra rewards in both games for playing!
